title: Why People Get Attracted to Toxic Partners
speaker: Anshuman Joshi
topic: Attachment, toxicity, psychology of attraction, and nervous system patterns

core_message.hinglish: Log toxic logon ke paas isliye nahi jate kyunki wo galat hain, balki isliye jate hain kyunki unka brain familiar pain ko love samajh leta hai.
core_message.english: People do not choose toxic partners because they are foolish; they choose them because their brain mistakes familiar pain for love.

main_observation.hinglish: Aksar caring aur emotionally available log ignore ho jate hain, jabki rude, unpredictable aur emotionally unavailable log zyada attractive lagte hain.
main_observation.english: Often kind and emotionally available people are ignored, while rude, unpredictable, and emotionally unavailable people appear more attractive.

why_this_happens.hinglish: Brain healthy cheezon se nahi, familiar patterns se attract hota hai.
why_this_happens.english: The brain is attracted to what feels familiar, not what is healthy.

why_this_happens.hinglish: Agar koi chaos ya emotional ups-and-downs me bada hua ho, to uska brain yahi normal maan leta hai.
why_this_happens.english: If someone grew up in emotional chaos, their brain assumes this is what connection looks like.

why_this_happens.hinglish: Kabhi attention, kabhi distance — yeh inconsistency dopamine release karti hai.
why_this_happens.english: Hot-and-cold behavior releases dopamine and creates emotional addiction.

why_this_happens.reason: Falling in love with hope, not the person
why_this_happens.hinglish: Log insaan se nahi, is umeed se pyar karte hain ki wo badal jayega.
why_this_happens.english: People fall in love with the hope that the toxic person will change.

why_this_happens.hinglish: Jab koi apni value sure nahi hota, to wo toxic logon se validation dhundhta hai.
why_this_happens.english: Low self-worth makes people chase partners who withhold love.

why_this_happens.hinglish: Kuch log sochte hain ki wo toxic insaan ko 'theek' kar sakte hain.
why_this_happens.english: Some people believe they can heal or save a toxic partner.

why_this_happens.hinglish: Emotional rollercoaster ko log passion samajh lete hain.
why_this_happens.english: People mistake emotional chaos for passion.

why_this_happens.hinglish: Stress normal lagne lagta hai, isliye peace boring lagti hai.
why_this_happens.english: When your nervous system is used to chaos, peace feels uncomfortable.

psychological_clarity.hinglish: Log toxic relationships me isliye nahi rehte kyunki wo weak hain; balki unka brain intensity, familiarity aur attachment me confused hota hai.
psychological_clarity.english: People stay in toxic relationships not because they are weak, but because their brain is confused between intensity, familiarity, and real connection.

warning_sign.hinglish: Agar tumhe healthy relationship boring lagti hai aur toxic log exciting lagte hain, to yeh pyar nahi — yeh healing ki zarurat hai.
warning_sign.english: If healthy relationships feel boring and toxic ones feel exciting, this is not love — it is a sign your nervous system needs healing.

final_takeaway.hinglish: Toxic attraction ka solution insaan badalna nahi, apna nervous system heal karna hai.
final_takeaway.english: The cure is not changing the person — it is healing your nervous system and self-worth.
